events.title: Francis Light Founds a British Settlement on Penang
events.description: Captain Francis Light of the British East India Company took possession of the island of Penang off the Malay Peninsula. He renamed it Prince of Wales Island. The settlement grew into George Town.
events.significance: It gave Britain its first major trading base in the Straits of Malacca. That base shaped the later growth of British power in Southeast Asia and the rise of modern Penang.

events.title: Alcatraz Opens as a Federal Prison
events.description: The first inmates arrived at Alcatraz Island in San Francisco Bay, and the island began its career as a federal penitentiary. Its cold waters and isolation made escape seem close to impossible.
events.significance: Alcatraz became the most famous prison in America and a lasting part of popular culture. It held notorious criminals until it closed in 1963.

events.title: King Hussein Takes the Jordanian Throne
events.description: King Talal of Jordan was forced to abdicate because of mental illness. His eldest son, Hussein, succeeded him.
events.significance: Hussein ruled for nearly five decades and guided Jordan through several Arab-Israeli wars and regional upheaval. He was a central figure in Middle East diplomacy.

events.title: Vostok 3 Carries Andriyan Nikolayev into Orbit
events.description: The Soviet Union launched Vostok 3 from the Baikonur Cosmodrome with cosmonaut Andriyan Nikolayev aboard. He became the first person to float freely in microgravity.
events.significance: The flight showed that humans could live and work in weightlessness for extended periods. That was an important step toward longer missions in space.

events.title: The Watts Riots Begin in Los Angeles
events.description: A confrontation between police and residents in the Watts neighborhood of Los Angeles set off several days of unrest.
events.significance: The riots drew national attention to economic inequality, housing discrimination, and tensions between police and Black communities. They also shaped debates over urban policy in the years that followed.
